Examine only the attached image pixels. Do not read files, use tools, consult prior sessions, or infer unreadable text. Transcribe this board-game card exactly. Return: ORIENTATION; TITLE; TYPE_LINE; BODY_TEXT verbatim with line breaks, capitalization, punctuation, and literal bracketed descriptions for icons; every standalone icon and location; whether it is a self-contained item or instructs gaining another physical card; UNCERTAIN_OR_ILLEGIBLE. Describe icon morphology before assigning a game meaning. Do not modify files.

[Image attached at: /home/smithers/nemesis-retaliation/assets/tts-mod/extract/v2-dl/tree/cards/game/yellowitem-145_cards/card-00.png]
[screenshot]

ORIENTATION: Portrait; upright.

TITLE: DUCT TAPE

TYPE_LINE: ONE USE ONLY

BODY_TEXT:
Discard a [gray cogwheel icon with eight teeth, a dark circular center, and three small round marks around its upper edge; Malfunction icon]

OR

Place this Item and 1 another
Heavy Item under a Heavy Item
in your Hand slot.

STANDALONE_ICONS:
- Upper-right of title panel: [white angular symbol resembling two overlapping or crossed item silhouettes, overlaid by a large red X]. Game meaning cannot be assigned confidently from the pixels.
- Inline after “Discard a”: [gray cogwheel icon with eight teeth, a dark circular center, and three small round marks around its upper edge]. Likely Malfunction icon.

ITEM_STATUS: Self-contained Item. It does not instruct gaining another physical card; it instructs placing this Item and 1 other Heavy Item under a Heavy Item already in your Hand slot.

UNCERTAIN_OR_ILLEGIBLE:
- The exact game meaning of the upper-right crossed-out white symbol is uncertain.
- The cogwheel’s assignment as a Malfunction icon is visually probable but not textually stated on the card.
